source: Model rows of the price table of the Arabic Token-Tax Index 0.1.0 (config/prices.yaml); prices, model versions and source URLs re-read from the vendors' official price pages on 2026-10-30 (index_price keeps the index value and date).
notes: List prices in USD per million tokens as shown on the vendors' official price pages at checked_at; no batch, cache or off-peak discounts. A row with a price_note is not a regular list price: the note says why (for example a promotional price and the date it runs to). page_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the page HTML as served.
